title: Remove the added 2 first
text: The equation adds 2 after dividing $$x$$ by 3. Subtract 2 from both sides before you multiply by 3. A common mistake is to multiply 6 by 3 and ignore the 2, getting 18. What is $$6 - 2$$?

title: Undo the division
text: You now have $$\frac{x}{3} = 4$$. Multiply both sides by 3. What is $$4 \times 3$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$\frac{x}{3} + 2 = 6$$. Subtract 2: $$\frac{x}{3} = 4$$. Multiply by 3: $$x = 12$$. Check: $$\frac{12}{3} + 2 = 6$$. Common mistake: $$x = 6 \times 3 - 2$$ computed in the wrong order. General rule: peel off addition and subtraction before you undo multiplication or division.
